title: Weight, style, line height
learningObjectives: Explain weight, style, line height and apply it in a readable interface.

understand.concept: font-weight controls stroke weight, font-style commonly selects normal or italic, and line-height controls the height of line boxes. Numeric font weights are often expressed from 100 to 900, but actual supported values depend on the font.
understand.whyItMatters: A browser may synthesize a weight or style if a font file does not provide it. Unitless line-height scales with the element's font size and is often convenient for readable text.
understand.analogy: Weight changes visual stroke, style changes letter form, and line-height changes vertical rhythm. These are separate controls.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy builds intuition; actual rendering follows CSS layout rules and browser specifications.

explain.narrative: The heading is heavier than the paragraph. The paragraph uses a unitless line-height of 1.6.
